github.description: Primary server for GitHub operations including pull requests, issues, Actions, branch protection, and releases

pullRequests.create: Create pull requests with title, body, base, head, labels, assignees, and reviewers
pullRequests.list: List pull requests with filters (state, base, head, author, label)
pullRequests.get: Get detailed PR information including commits, files, reviews, and status checks
pullRequests.update: Update PR title, body, state, labels, assignees, and reviewers
pullRequests.merge: Merge pull requests with configurable merge methods (merge, squash, rebase)
pullRequests.review: Create, submit, and manage PR reviews and comments
pullRequests.requestReviewers: Request reviews from users or teams
pullRequests.files: List files changed in a pull request

issues.create: Create issues with title, body, labels, assignees, and milestone

branches.get: Get branch details and protection status
branches.create: Create new branches from reference points
branches.protection: Configure branch protection rules, required reviews, status checks, and restrictions

repositories.list: List repositories for user or organization

workflows.jobs: View workflow job details and logs

releases.create: Create releases with tag, name, body, and assets

usageNotes: Token needs repo, workflow, and admin:repo_hook scopes for full functionality

filesystem.description: Local filesystem access for git repository operations and configuration

fileOperations.read: Read files including git config, hooks, and repository files
fileOperations.write: Write git hooks, configuration files, and templates
fileOperations.search: Search for files and patterns in repository

gitOperations.config: Read and analyze git configuration files
gitOperations.hooks: Install and manage git hooks (pre-commit, commit-msg, pre-push, etc.)
gitOperations.templates: Manage PR templates, issue templates, and other .github files
gitOperations.attributes: Configure .gitattributes for LFS and merge strategies
